pages.text: The Prophet ﷺ came to Madinah and stayed in its upper part, with a people called Banu Amr ibn Awf.

Then he stopped in the courtyard of the house of Abu Ayyub, and ordered the mosque to be built. He said to Banu an-Najjar: “O Banu an-Najjar, name me a price for this walled garden of yours.” (Sahih al-Bukhari 428) — that is: sell me this garden of yours.
They said: “No, by Allah! We seek its price only from Allah.” (Sahih al-Bukhari 428)

The palm trees were cut down and set in a row as the qiblah of the mosque, and they began carrying the rocks, and the Prophet ﷺ was with them, saying: “O Allah, there is no good except the good of the Hereafter, so forgive the Ansar and the Muhajirun.” (Sahih al-Bukhari 428)
